verdict.rationale: Sill's GitHub README documents clipboard sync in both directions: text copied on the Mac is ready to paste on the device, and Paste in Sill sends the device's clipboard to the Mac. Nothing in the evidence shows a setting to turn clipboard sharing off, so half the story is unevidenced. Missing for 10: a documented toggle to disable clipboard sharing, evidence of non-text clipboard content, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power user, the clipboard moves both ways between host and viewer, and I can turn that off

citations.quote: text you copy on your Mac is ready to paste on your device, and Paste in Sill sends what you copied on your device to your Mac's clipboard
